ok, but how did you register @fucodex?

reply_text:
㊥ (how @fucodex was registered) I registered @fucodex on 14 September from a shell on lucy, which hosts your own homeserver. No separate administrator account was needed:
1. **Create the account.** Over `ssh lucy-joe`, I ran Synapse's own registration tool inside its container:
   `docker exec matrix-synapse register_new_matrix_user -c /data/homeserver.yaml -u fucodex -p <random password> --no-admin http://localhost:8008`
   The tool signs the request with the `registration_shared_secret` in `homeserver.yaml`, so being able to get into the container is all the authority it needs.
2. **Get the token.** A password login (`POST /_matrix/client/v3/login`) to `127.0.0.1:8008` on lucy returned the access token.
3. **Store the credentials.** The password and token went into `~/.config/futon3c/matrix/fucodex.{password,token}` (mode 600 in a 700 directory). Neither was ever printed.

The script did the same for fuclaude and fuzai, and skipped any nick that already had a token.

㊟ (the line you quoted) "A homeserver administrator must provision the account" is true in general Matrix terms. Here, though, anyone who can SSH to `lucy-joe` is effectively that administrator. Your Codex in the fork can do it the same way if it has that SSH access. Otherwise I can do it from here.

🈸 (one decision) Shall I provision the publisher account now? If so, tell me the nick you want (for example `@fumarimo`) and which room it should join. The token would go next to the others in `~/.config/futon3c/matrix/` on lucy. If the publisher runs on Zone, I'll also put a copy there.

previous_reply_acts.author: claude-17
previous_reply_acts.text:
(what the spec asks for) There are two commits in `element-web-futon`, item 4 first, because item 1 builds on the call sites it changes:
- **Item 4:** one poller per room instead of a 10-second timer on every message. It fetches a turn's details only when its status changes, and stops once the turn is final. The author scan runs only for Marimo requests.
- **Item 1:** a turn's marks come from 象's analysis if it has arrived, otherwise from 小象's draft, otherwise from the lexical cues. Draft marks are dotted and labelled 小象. Marks the author typed are drawn solid. Unsure fragments show "?" with their two guesses.
- **Checks:**
  - lint, the vitest unit tests for `src/customisations/`, and `build-futon.sh` must pass;
  - then a manual check that 小象 marks appear within seconds and give way to 象's;
  - and that the turn list is requested once per 10 s per room.

previous_reply_acts.text:
(found while writing it) The chat proxy let any member of the room read every session's turns, including your Emacs turns. Two things leaked:
- The turn list returned the newest 300 turns from all sessions, with full text.
- Any turn could be fetched by its id.
